about_the_game:
Divine Wish is a first-person roguelike shooter with a unique sticker system.

Survive in the surge of battle, choose stickers that change your abilities and characteristics, and compete against waves of enemies in a dynamic FPS roguelike.

FPS + roguelike: an explosive mix

Divine Wish is a high-speed first-person shooter where each run is a unique challenge. Explore random combinations of weapons and artifacts, adapt to new threats, and prove your skills in boss fights.

Speed, reaction, and accuracy are key skills for your survival.

No saves - every death brings you back to the beginning, but with a new experience.

Each attempt is unique thanks to a system of classes and random artifacts.

Stickers that change your abilities

There are no classic character classes in Divine Wish - you choose how to play!

Before each race, you get a sticker that gives you unique effects and changes the gameplay. But it's not that simple - each sticker gives you both a powerful bonus and a weakness, so you have to choose wisely.

Boss battles

Every 10th wave is an epic boss battle that will test your skills to the brim.

Unique attacks and mechanics make you adapt to each battle.

The gradual increase in difficulty ensures that you will not have an easy time.

Only the best players will be able to defeat all the bosses and complete the game.

Death is only the beginning

As in any roguelike, each run is a chance to become stronger. Explore enemies, experiment with stickers, and find your perfect playstyle.

Divine Wish is an explosive combination of roguelike and FPS. Ready to take on the challenge?

name: Divine Wish

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4770K or AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 GB available space

short_description: Divine Wish is a fast-paced roguelike shooter with various classes and special abilities. Find your play style, survive waves of enemies, and use artifacts to change the tides of the battle. Die, learn, adapt!
